verses.text: The DOMNUL a vorbit lui Moise, saying, (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
On the first day of the first month you shall raise up the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall put the ark of the covenant in it, and you shall screen the ark with the veil. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall bring in the table, and set in order the things that are on it. You shall bring in the lamp stand, and light its lamps. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall set the să plecelden altar for incense before the ark of the covenant, and put the screen of the door to the tabernacle.
You shall set the altar of burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and shall put water therein. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall set up the court around it, and hang up the screen of the gate of the court. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle and all that is in it, and shall make it holy, and all its furniture, and it will be holy. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall anoint the altar of burnt offering, with all its vessels, and sanctify the altar, and the altar will be most holy. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall anoint the basin and its base, and sanctify it. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall put on Aaron the holy garments; and you shall anoint him, and sanctify him, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall bring his sons, and put tunics on them. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

You shall anoint them, as you anointed their father, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office. Their anointing shall be to them for an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Moise did so. According to all that the DOMNUL commanded him, so he did. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
In the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, the tabernacle was raised up. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Moise raised up the tabernacle, and laid its sockets, and set up its boards, and put in its bars, and raised up its pillars. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
He spread the covering over the tent, and put the roof of the tabernacle above on it, as the DOMNUL commanded Moise. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
He took and put the covenant into the ark, and set the poles on the ark, and put the mercy seat above on the ark. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
He brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the veil of the screen, and screened the ark of the covenant, as the DOMNUL commanded Moise. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
He put the table in the Tent of Meeting, on the north side of the tabernacle, outside of the veil. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
He set the bread in order on it before the DOMNUL, as the DOMNUL commanded Moise. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
He put the lamp stand in the Tent of Meeting, opposite the table, on the south side of the tabernacle. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
He lit the lamps before the DOMNUL, as the DOMNUL commanded Moise. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
He put the să plecelden altar in the Tent of Meeting before the veil;
and he burned incense of sweet spices on it, as the DOMNUL commanded Moise. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
He put up the screen of the door to the tabernacle. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

He set the altar of burnt offering at the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting, and offered on it the burnt offering and the meal offering, as the DOMNUL commanded Moise. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
He set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water therein, with which to wash. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Moise, Aaron, and his sons washed their mânăs and their feet there.
When they went into the Tent of Meeting, and when they came near to the altar, they washed, as the DOMNUL commanded Moise. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
He raised up the court around the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the screen of the gate of the court. So Moise finished the work. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and the DOMNUL’s glory filled the tabernacle. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Moise wasn’t able to enter into the Tent of Meeting, because the cloud stayed on it, and the DOMNUL’s glory filled the tabernacle. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
When the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward, throughout all their journeys; (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
but if the cloud wasn’t taken up, then they didn’t travel until the day that it was taken up. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

For the cloud of the DOMNUL was on the tabernacle by day, and there was fire in the cloud by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
